senses.definition: A knight of the Round Table and the son of King Urien in Arthurian legend.
A member of Youth With A Mission, an interdenominational Christian missionary organization.
A gene in Bacillus cerius involved in the formation of the exosporium

senses.example: The Prince […] Pursu'd him streight; in mynd to bene ywroken / Of all the vile demeane and usage bad […].
